blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation applied to Public Safety & Justice. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

Police, fire, EMS and courts coordinate under minutes-matter constraints and the strictest accountability: evidence integrity, proportionality and privacy. Dataq Software engineers the intelligence layer with auditability as a design primitive, not a feature.

items: Reports, discovery and scheduling consume officer/court time.
Dispatch, records and evidence systems siloed; coordination manual.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Agentic Process Automation, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration, Autonomous Workflow Orchestration from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Dispatch and coordination, Evidence management, Report generation) on Dataq Swarm and Dataq Nexus and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — Criminal-procedure rules among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: See the work as it actually runs: event-log truth before you automate anything.
One automation spine: APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.
Workflows that recover from failure on their own — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
Narrative drafting with officer review (burden down 30-50%)

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Public Sector & Government level this capability reads as: cross-agency analytics scoring anomalies with investigator case packs (capture up at stable load). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Delivery follows the same weekly rhythm on every program of this type. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
